name: Eiffel Tower replica, Bahria Town Lahore
assumptions: Heading 358: the tower is taken as square with the OSM park ring; the photos cannot give a bearing.
Base 31.25 m outer square is derived from 1:4 scale and agrees with the aerial and far views.
Height 80 m to the mast tip from the dossier; mast length is estimated.
Platform levels (frieze 15.2 to 17.8 m, canopy 21 m, second deck 33.6 m, gallery 72 m) were read from photos and may be out by about 1 m.
Raised plaza 1.8 m high and 47 m square, from one aerial photo; step count is an estimate.
All four sides of the plaza have the same planter, stairs and planting; only two sides are visible in photos.
Lattice panel counts are close to the photos but are not counted bar by bar; the upper shaft has 13 panels.
Lift shaft glazing height in the upper stage is read from a single photo.
Night colours follow the magenta, blue and red scheme in one photo; the scheme appears to change between dates.
The small kiosks, lamp posts, gardens and pools in the park are outside this model.
